title: Ultraviolet-C to mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in periodically poled lithium tantalate waveguides
task: Generate ultraviolet-C to mid-infrared supercontinuum on chip via chirped periodically poled lithium tantalate
key_results: Shortest UV wavelength from chip <270 nm (UV-C); extended to 2400 nm (mid-IR); >3 octaves coverage with 100 pJ pulse energy; first full UV-A/B coverage with UV-C extension
comments: Chirped ferroelectric domains enable unprecedented bandwidth; quasi-phase-matching via 3-wave-mixing avoids material dispersion/absorption limitations of bulk approaches; opens integrated UV photonics platform.

title: Three-phase ScAlN-based PMUT-driven acoustic streaming micropump
task: Develop ScAlN PMUT-driven acoustic streaming micropump for microfluidic applications
key_results: Three-phase 1.2×1.6 mm device achieves 0.12 μL/min flow rate (experimental), 1.0 μL/min predicted (optimized); CMOS-compatible; excellent agreement with multiphysics simulations
comments: Phase-staggered driving (120° between adjacent cells) induces directional streaming; compact footprint and low flow-rate precision suit μTAS; optimization of kerf and phase difference enables 8× flow enhancement.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Three-phase PMUT drive induces directional acoustic streaming sufficient for micropumping

title: Survival of the metallic state in a single-hole multiband p-orbital molecular system
task: Demonstrate metallic state survival in single-hole multiorbital p-electron system via Hund's coupling
key_results: Orthorhombic Yb₂CsC₆₀ (C₆₀⁵⁻ pentavalent) exhibits robust metallicity at n=5 (one hole); particle–hole symmetry holds in fullerides; p-electron states analogous to d-orbital solids
comments: Ferroelectric Hund's coupling in fullerides opposes correlations at n=1,5, enabling metallicity unlike half-filled Mott insulators; analogy to d-orbital systems enriches understanding of multiorbital correlation physics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hund's coupling reduces Mott gap and enables metallicity in single-hole multiorbital p-electron systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Yb₂CsC₆₀ metallic, analogous to single-electron/hole d-orbital systems

title: Quantum beats of exciton-polarons in CsPbI3 perovskite nanocrystals
task: Observe quantum beats of exciton-polaron states in CsPbI₃ nanocrystals via coherent optical spectroscopy
key_results: Long coherence times T₂≈300 ps; exciton-polaron quantum beats with 5–15 ps decay (optical phonon lifetimes); Huang–Rhys factors 0.05–0.12 (3.2 meV), 0.02–0.04 (5.1 meV); pronounced size dependence
comments: Transient two-pulse photon echo at 2 K resolves exciton-phonon coupling strength; size-tunable coherence and phonon dynamics enable tailored optical response for solid-state quantum technologies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exciton-polaron quantum beats reveal strong size-dependent exciton-phonon coupling in perovskite nanocrystals
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pronounced size dependence of Huang–Rhys factors and phonon lifetimes observed

task: Design self-charged polar nematic monopoles and hybrid topological states via confinement asymmetry

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confinement asymmetry tailors and diversifies electrically polar topological solitons

task: Establish link between moiré ferroelectric node topology and mechanical response under AFM perturbation
key_results: Symmetric sixfold nodes dynamically robust; asymmetric sixfold nodes displaced/guided by AFM tip; fourfold nodes fractured due to lack of topological protection; topology governs mechanical stability

title: Robust flat-magnetoresistivity in D03-Fe3Ga driven by chiral anomaly

comments: D₀₃-Fe₃Ga exhibits pristine topological flat-band semimetal characteristics absent in previous systems; 33 T robustness of flat-MR demonstrates unambiguous Fermi-level intersection with flattened Weyl crossings.

title: Achieving non-degenerate sliding ferroelectricity via band-edge pinning: an instructive design principle for controllable photocatalysis and photovoltaics
task: Engineer non-degenerate sliding ferroelectric phases for enhanced photovoltaic and photocatalytic control
key_results: MoSi₂N₄/WSi₂N₄ heterobilayer exhibits non-degenerate AB/AC phases; strong visible absorption (~10⁵ cm⁻¹); AC phase provides enhanced redox, AB phase suppresses recombination; solar-to-hydrogen efficiency optimized

hypotheses.hypothesis: Band-edge pinning generates non-degenerate sliding ferroelectric phases with opposite carrier dynamics
